non_mutating_command_notes: An initial sha256sum -c invocation was issued from the project root although the frozen manifest uses result-directory-relative paths; it failed open without changing any file. Repeating the same check from the frozen result directory passed 16 of 16.

An initial path-containment assertion used pathlib.Path.is_relative_to under system Python 3.8 and stopped with AttributeError after confirming relative paths and no parent traversal. The Python-3.8-compatible os.path.commonpath assertion then passed for all 210 strings. No NPZ was opened in either check.

condition_definitions.native_qc: Use the checkpoint-native beta=1 conditioner without intervention.
condition_definitions.bias_zero: Runner-locally replace the conditioner contact_probability input by ones, making beta*log(p)=0 without changing beta or any persistent state.
condition_definitions.case_mean_probability: Runner-locally replace every proxy probability by the original case-wise mean probability.
condition_definitions.fixed_seed_within_case_probability_permu: Permute original probability values within the case, preserving the exact multiset while destroying proxy-space alignment.

frozen_protocol.negative_control_identity: case_mean_probability and bias_zero must be softmax-equivalent because each differs only by a query-wise constant logit shift.
frozen_protocol.permutation_seed_derivation: Take the first eight bytes, big-endian, of SHA256(protocol_id + '|' + fold + '|' + case_id + '|probability_permutation'), then reduce modulo 2**63; Python hash() is forbidden.
frozen_protocol.frozen_q0_reference: Reuse only the frozen v2 Q0 per-case metrics; do not load or rerun Q0 in Round A-I.
frozen_protocol.future_data_order: Open each allowlisted NPZ at most once; obtain partial for four forwards, then obtain metric-only implant and gt under the existing no-label-leakage contract.
frozen_protocol.state_immutability: Hash every parameter and buffer before the first condition and after the final condition for each checkpoint; require exact equality and require every temporary hook to be removed.
